_meta.feast: Sunday of the Holy Fathers (Ecumenical Councils)
_meta._source: OCA/Lambertsen order for the Sunday of the Holy Fathers — saintjonah.org lit_hf6councils_pent7 (First Six Councils) and lit_hf7council_pent19 (Seventh Council), which share the same Liturgy Beatitudes. The four troparia are the whole of Ode 3 of the First Canon of the Fathers, Tone 6 (Beatitudes 7-10 in the 'on 10' layout); the fourth is the Theotokion. Register: archaic (thee/thy), matching our Lambertsen menaion source.
_meta._note: Movable feast — attached by name (not by date key) via buildBeatitudesTroparia's feastCanonOverride param when liturgy-from-orthocal.js detects the Holy Fathers Councils Sunday. beatitudesReplaceGloryNow drops the Octoechos Glory+Theotokion tail so the count is exactly 6 Resurrection + 4 Fathers = on 10, ending in the Fathers' own Theotokion.

troparia.text: The mindless Arius, showing himself to be a servant of a created being, and Macedonius, likewise revealed as abominable, are tormented together in the fire of Gehenna with the heathen.
troparia.label: For the Fathers

troparia.text: With the seven sacred councils of the holy fathers didst thou adorn the honored Church, O Christ, driving far away the darkness of deception as with the light of seven beacons.
troparia.label: For the Fathers

troparia.text: The multifarious murrain of the heretics destroyeth Thy flock, O Word; but the shepherds of Thy noetic sheep have cured this by their doctrine.
troparia.label: For the Fathers

troparia.text: O all-pure one, thou gavest birth unto One of the uncreated Trinity, who is two in nature, and volition, and Whose image we venerate, filled with grace.
troparia.label: Theotokion
